feature: Toppan delivery gate: stage naik hanya setelah file terenkripsi terkonfirmasi sampai di SFTP Toppan (polling record COMCRYPT), dengan bypass saat upload Toppan diblok
note: Gate pengiriman (OCMS-DEV-2026-199) menahan kenaikan stage sampai file terkonfirmasi terkirim, dan di-bypass saat sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan (OCMS-DF-2026-192, Ready to UAT). Tidak disebut di story 13.11/13.15 sehingga tidak dipakai sebagai bukti; ia justru menjelaskan kenapa stage maju tanpa pengiriman.
note_en: The delivery gate (OCMS-DEV-2026-199) holds the stage advance until the file is confirmed delivered and is bypassed while sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan (OCMS-DF-2026-192, Ready to UAT). Stories 13.11/13.15 do not mention it, so it is not used as evidence; it explains why the stage advances without delivery.

feature: Admin fee (parameter ADM) ditambahkan ke amount payable pada stage DR3/RR3 dan dikosongkan di stage lain
note: Pada DR3 amount_payable = composition_amount + administration_fee (ADM), dan di stage non-RR3/DR3 admin fee ditulis 0 (OCMS-DF-2026-170). Story OCMS13.15 tidak menyebut admin fee; mungkin tercakup story lain di epic ini (belum dicek). Nilai ADM per stage ada di tabel parameter: cannot verify from repo.
note_en: At DR3 amount_payable = composition_amount + administration_fee (ADM), and at non-RR3/DR3 stages the admin fee is written as 0 (OCMS-DF-2026-170). Story OCMS13.15 does not mention an admin fee; another story in this epic may cover it (not checked). The ADM value per stage sits in the parameter table: cannot verify from repo.

feature: Pencatatan tracking Driver Notice (ocms_driver_notice) saat stage DN1/DN2/DR3 selesai diproses
note: Setelah letter stage DN1/DN2/DR3 diproses, notice dicatat ke ocms_driver_notice (RD1/RD2/RR3 ke ocms_request_driver_particulars). Tidak ada story 13.11/13.15 yang meminta pencatatan ini; sifatnya pendukung audit tracking.
note_en: After a DN1/DN2/DR3 letter is processed the notice is recorded in ocms_driver_notice (RD1/RD2/RR3 go to ocms_request_driver_particulars). Neither story 13.11 nor 13.15 asks for this record; it supports tracking and audit.
